title: CollectionAPI
summary: USD collections, applied as CollectionAPI:<name>. The parser resolves a collection to the includes targets expanded through their descendants, minus the excludes subtrees. It does so for the colliders collection of a PhysicsCollisionGroup and the quasistaticactors collection of PhysxSceneQuasistaticAPI.
producer_scope: Authored includes and excludes relationships are published like any relationship. ovstage also lists the bare name CollectionAPI next to every CollectionAPI:<name> entry.

columns.name: collection:<inst>:includes
columns.notes: Every target contributes itself and all its descendants.

columns.name: collection:<inst>:excludes
columns.notes: Every target removes itself and all its descendants from the expanded includes.

interactions.rule: Reads the colliders instance; that component lists collection:colliders:includes and :excludes as its own columns.
Reads the quasistaticactors instance on the scene, only when that API is applied; the compiled cache does not support that API, so a Stage using it bypasses the cache.

notes: expansionRule, includeRoot and membershipExpression are not read: includes always expand to all descendants.
Instance names are arbitrary, so the compiled cache declares every collection:* column.
